\begin{lemma}\label{lem:add-zero} For every natural number $n$, $n + 0 = n$.\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}By the definition of addition.\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:zero-add} For every natural number $n$, $0 + n = n$.\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}By induction on $n$.\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:false} In the natural numbers, $0 = 1$.\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}This is immediate.\end{proof}
